_comment: Copy to luna.config.json (gitignored). 'hub' = your workspace path (default '.' = the luna folder). 'models' = model policy. The ORCHESTRATOR (the session you talk to via the terminal) is ALWAYS your max model + effort - a strong boss orchestrates the workers well. LANES (workers) default to laneDefault and can be overridden per lane (e.g. :team proj bugs=opus,triage=haiku). Models: haiku | sonnet | opus | claude-fable-5. Effort: low | medium | high | xhigh.
